summary: Re-audit of Phase S3 after remediation round 2 at audited head b6ae211f passes. (1) The 0dcc9ef1 sweep is safe as designed: it deletes only untracked folders, one directory level deep, by prefix match on ['.oxlint-adv', '.oxlint-probe-'], only under the repo root and the apps/* and packages/* workspace folders (oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:152); a folder with a tracked file is skipped (the git ls-files guard at line 160, verified at command level: 'git ls-files -- apps/integrated-math-3' names tracked files, 'git ls-files -- apps/.oxlint-probe-LEAK' is empty); a git failure exits through 'tracked.status !== 0' and skips; a symlink entry fails entry.isDirectory() and is skipped, so nothing outside the target is reachable (live probe: a symlink named .oxlint-adv-link left the canary file intact). (2) The gate-red leak class of my r2 F2 and adversarial F1r2 is fixed live: the brief's LEAKPROBE (seeded apps/integrated-math-3/.oxlint-adv13-LEAKPROBE/seed.ts) was swept during '-t S2 adversarial' (13 passed) and left no probe path in git status; all 10 in-repo seed sites now route through seedDir and every remaining mkdtempSync uses os.tmpdir; no assertion was weakened in 0dcc9ef1 (the diff only adds the helpers, the beforeAll, and re-routes the seeds). One residual gap (new F7): the sweep parent list omits the apps/ directory level itself, so a leaked apps/.oxlint-probe-* folder (makeLintProbe, line 1295) is not swept; proven live, the seeded folder survived a full oxc-file run, all 51 tests still passed, so it is debris only and no deterministic test turns red. (3) The four ad33c8a1 cases assert what their names say (r2 a pins the errno data-form residual with paired controls and a new_keys check; r2 c pins the strategy 16.7 code-290 trade-off; r2 d seeds the real Node/npm blocks and pins the trailer-only miss; r2 e pins the canonical and near-miss field forms). (4) The plan Round 2 sub-box and the Green r6 log claims match: every count I re-ran reproduces exactly. (5) Suite re-runs in a detached worktree at b6ae211f: the gates-script file 23 passed, 'S3 adversarial' 12 passed, 'S3 tsrs' 8 passed, 'S2 adversarial' 13 passed, the full scripts suite 1 failed | 84 passed of 85 with the single pre-existing remediate-concept-blueprints row, and 'npx tsc --noEmit' exit 0. The r2 F1 (Rust os error 28 and spawn ENOSPC forms) is withdrawn here and routed to S4 Red as the plan records; the r1 checkpoint items F3 to F6 carry unchanged.

F8 [Nit] review-a: sweepStaleProbeDirs (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:151-165) removes any untracked prefix-matching folder regardless of age, so two overlapping suite runs in the same checkout can interfere: run B's beforeAll can delete run A's freshly seeded live folders and turn run A red with a failure that names no code change, the same false-red class as F1r2. Rationale: exposure is low today because heavy runs are serialized and parallel role sessions use separate checkouts (this audit ran in a detached worktree), and the design deliberately trades the age guard for simplicity; an mtime guard (skip folders younger than process start) would close it if parallel same-checkout runs ever become routine.
